title: US Stock Futures Gain as Nasdaq 100 Looks to Snap Five-Day Slump
summary: Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.6% in early Friday trading, on track to end a five-day losing streak as Treasury yields stabilize and Bitcoin soars. S&P 500 futures added 0.4%. The Nasdaq 100 had been weighed down all week by surging long-dated Treasury yields and oil prices.
why: 纳指连跌5日后期货反弹，科技板块短期压力暂缓；Nvidia财报（8/26）临近是下周最大催化剂，本周隐含波动率若有回落可考虑布局sell put。

title: Treasury Doubles Debt Buybacks to $4B as 30-Year Yield Hits Near 19-Year High
summary: The US Treasury doubled long-term debt buyback operations from $2B to at least $4B per operation starting Sept. 9, after 30-year yields hit their highest level since before the 2008 global financial crisis. Treasury Secretary Bessent framed it as a liquidity measure; yields initially fell ~10 bps but subsequently reversed all gains, prompting Bessent to signal further expansion is possible.
why: 美国30年债收益率逼近19年高点，是本周全球股市最大压制因素；Bessent被迫两度出手，折射债市流动性风险；对成长股估值（如Nvidia、谷歌）及期权隐含波动率均有直接影响，持仓需提高对冲意识。

title: Oil Sustains Gains Above $93 as US-Iran Conflict Keeps Hormuz Risk Premium Elevated
summary: Brent crude traded above $93/barrel and WTI near $87/barrel this week, on track for a second consecutive weekly gain of more than 5%, as the US-Iran conflict over the Strait of Hormuz continued. The UAE suspended financial transactions with Iran following missile attacks; Trump announced an 'economic D-day' against Tehran.
why: 油价持续高位拖累通胀预期，令美联储降息空间收窄，对成长股及科技板块估值形成压制；同时能源成本上升将侵蚀美国消费者支出（参见Walmart业绩）。地缘风险窗口应维持适度期权对冲。

title: 香港7月综合CPI按年升1.7%，通胀连续三个月放缓
summary: 香港统计处公布，7月综合消费物价指数（CPI）按年升1.7%，低于6月的2.0%，连续放缓。扣除政府一次性纾困措施后，基本通胀率为1.9%，与前月持平。电力、燃气及水费涨幅最大（+10.8%），但整体压力温和，大多数分类保持平稳。
why: 港股通胀降温有助维持相对宽松货币预期，对持有估值偏高港股（腾讯、美团等）略偏正面；与此同时油价上行仍是制约通胀进一步回落的隐忧，需持续观察。

title: Bitcoin Surges Toward $80K; BTC and ETH Spot ETFs Pull in $800M for Second Straight Day
summary: Bitcoin rose above $79,000 on August 21, its highest level since June, gaining over 8% in 24 hours. Combined US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETF inflows reached $800M for the second consecutive session. Short sellers lost roughly $3B during the breakout. Bernstein analysts described the surge as a liquidity-driven momentum shift. Circle (CRCL) and other crypto-linked equities extended their rally.
why: 比特币逼近$80K关键位且ETF持续大额流入，稳定币赛道（Circle/USDC）受益；比特币强势周反弹提升风险情绪，对纳指科技股也有正向传导；同时Circle Arc Layer 1将于9/16上线，是独立催化剂。

title: Walmart Posts Slowest US Sales Growth in Six Years; Stock Plunges 9.5%
summary: Walmart Q2 US comparable-store sales rose 2.6%, missing the 3.7% consensus estimate — the weakest print in more than six years. Q3 adjusted EPS guidance of $0.62–$0.64 also came in below the $0.68 estimate. Despite total revenue of $187.9B and Q2 adjusted EPS of $0.81 both beating, the soft forward outlook hit the stock hard. Higher gas prices and subdued pharmacy sales were cited as key drags.
why: 沃尔玛股价跌9.5%是美国消费降级信号；高油价压缩居民可支配收入，传导至消费板块（麦当劳、好市多等）。对持有WMT的期权策略者：短期IV飙升，覆盖看涨（covered call）短期价值提升，但下行风险需重新评估。

title: 腾讯控股8月20日回购934,000股，耗资5.51亿港元
summary: 据港交所披露，腾讯控股（00700.HK）于8月20日回购934,000股股份，回购价介乎每股586至594港元，合计耗资5.51亿港元，为近期单日回购最大规模之一。自股东大会授权以来，腾讯已累计回购约4026.7万股，约占当时已发行股份的0.438%。
why: 腾讯在AI资本开支大幅攀升、二季度自由现金流转负的背景下持续大手笔回购，显示管理层对估值底部的信心；8月20日单日5.51亿港元为近期最大，对持股者有支撑作用，也提示期权买方需关注股价回调支撑位。
